description: This file defines a decorator class for handling CSS property values with !important, allowing or blocking the use of !important based on configuration.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_ImportantDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps another attribute definition to handle the !important CSS directive, enabling or disabling its use based on configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with another attribute definition and a flag to allow or disallow !important.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a CSS value string, detecting and optionally preserving !important, delegating overall validation to the wrapped attribute definition.
